first_page: News page /news/ for readers who want a calm, ad-free front page. First: "news" opens top stories gathered from several open sources (Wikipedia In the news, public RSS from major outlets, Hacker News) with source and age on each, section tabs, topics followed on the device, and a link holding the chosen sections. Will not build: original reporting, comments, video streaming or push alerts.
